title: Ular Dalam Bonet
subject: a Bomba snake-catching unit pulling a 4-metre python out of the engine bay of a Proton Saga in a Shah Alam shopping-mall car park while the owner livestreams the whole thing, begging viewers for likes and asking the firemen to wave
caption: Malaysian hardcore punk, fast old-school and youth-crew style with a mosh breakdown. Two distorted guitars playing open-chord blasts and palm-muted chugs; a gritty overdriven bass locked to the kick; live drums switching between d-beat and double-time thrash beats with crash-heavy fills; feedback ringing between sections. Raw, loud live-room basement mix, little reverb, slight tape grit. Female lead with a hoarse, shouted chest voice in hardcore cadence, a gang of mixed voices shouting the chorus back. 176 BPM, E minor. Furious, comic and indignant. No pop-punk melodies, no metalcore clean choruses, no death-metal growls, no autotune, no synths.
lyrics:
[Intro - guitar feedback, a drum count-in, gang shout]

[Verse 1]
Tingkat B2, panas macam ketuhar
Saga merah tak nak hidup, bunyi pelik bawah bonet
Buka sikit, ada sisik, ada mata
Empat meter ular sawa peluk enjin dia!

[Pre-Chorus]
Tuan kereta tak lari, tuan kereta pegang telefon
"Geng, tekan like! Bomba dah sampai!"

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Ular dalam bonet! Tarik! Tarik!
Bomba masuk, tangan dalam enjin!
Ular dalam bonet! Jangan live!
Abang, tolong ke tepi sikit!

[Verse 2]
Kayu cangkuk, guni, sarung tangan tebal
Ekor lilit kipas radiator dua kali
Pengawal parkir panjat atas tong sampah
Tuan kereta jerit, "Bang, lambai kat kamera!"

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Ular dalam bonet! Tarik! Tarik!
Bomba masuk, tangan dalam enjin!
Ular dalam bonet! Jangan live!
Seribu orang tengok kau menjerit!

[Bridge - half-time breakdown]
Satu, dua, tiga, angkat!
Kepala keluar, guni dah ikat

[Chorus - gang vocals, double time]
Ular dalam guni! Siap! Siap!
Bomba lap peluh, guard turun dari tong!
Kereta hidup, live pun habis
Komen pertama: "Ular tu lagi hensem!"

[Outro - double-time blast, dead stop]
